note: Schema backup of SOC 2 evidence tables, taken right after creation via the Airtable API. Source of truth is the base; refresh this file after every schema change.

tables.name: soc2_controls
tables.description: SOC 2 Evidence · MapKMigGon39264 (P02), created 2026-10-14. Catalog of SOC 2 controls (AICPA TSC) that evidence event types support; mapping is provisional until Max or Scrut confirm. Writers: designated editors only. Docs: repo mapking-dev stories/MapMigGon37539/data-implementation-plan.md §1.4.

fields.name: control_code
fields.description: Primary. TSC criterion code, e.g. CC7.2. Stable; never reused.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Control name (AICPA TSC 2017 wording, short).

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the control requires and what evidence supports it.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Evidence category used to group controls and events.

fields.name: scrut_task
fields.description: Scrut evidence task that receives this control's CSV, when known.

fields.name: recurrence
fields.description: Recurrence of the Scrut evidence task; defines the CSV export period.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Control in use. Inactive controls drop out of the event lookups (via active_code) without rewriting evidence.

fields.name: active_code
fields.description: control_code when active, empty otherwise. Looked up from soc2_event_types to get only active controls (replaces a conditional lookup, which the API cannot create).

fields.name: last_modified
fields.description: When the control definition last changed (audit of the mapping).

fields.name: last_modified_by
fields.description: Who last changed the control definition (audit of the mapping).

fields.name: event_types
fields.description: Inverse of soc2_event_types.controls: event types that support this control. Edit the mapping from soc2_event_types.

tables.name: soc2_event_types
tables.description: SOC 2 Evidence · Map MigGon37539 (structure) + MapKMigGon39261 (P01 events), created 2026-10-14. Catalog and documentation of studied events: one row per event_code. status (enabled, trace, paused, disabled) switches capture without code; detection rules live in airtable/soc2/soc2-capture.ts and must match version. Writers: designated editors only. Docs: stories/MapMigGon37539/soc2-event-catalog.md.

fields.name: event_code
fields.description: Primary. Stable code source.object.action, e.g. loom.sync.init. Never reused.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Readable short name.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the event is and why it is SOC 2 evidence.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Producer family of the event.

fields.name: source_table
fields.description: Map King Hub table where the event is detected (name and id).

fields.name: source_workflow
fields.description: For automation events: the source automation name and id (wfl...).

fields.name: detection
fields.description: Detection rule in words. Documents the rule coded in soc2-capture.ts.

fields.name: detection_config
fields.description: Detection rule as JSON. Documents the coded rule; must match it.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Outcome the event assigns.

fields.name: category
fields.description: SOC 2 evidence category.

fields.name: tsc_refs
fields.description: Tentative TSC criteria, e.g. CC7.2 (provisional).

fields.name: qualifies
fields.description: Passed the qualification checklist (attributable, maps to a control, clear outcome, integrity).

fields.name: qualification_notes
fields.description: Why it qualifies or what it lacks.

fields.name: status
fields.description: enabled: captured. trace: detected and logged in soc2_capture_runs, not written. paused: not captured for a while, no backfill. disabled: defined, not captured.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Version of the detection rule. Must match the version in soc2-capture.ts; a mismatch is reported as a config issue.

fields.name: mapping_provisional
fields.description: Control mapping not yet confirmed by Max or Scrut. Exported in the CSV.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Person responsible for this event definition.

fields.name: doc_url
fields.description: Documentation link.

fields.name: controls
fields.description: SOC 2 controls this event type supports (P02 mapping, by event type). Flag mapping_provisional until confirmed.

fields.name: last_modified
fields.description: When the event definition last changed.

fields.name: last_modified_by
fields.description: Who last changed the event definition.

fields.name: active_control_codes
fields.description: Codes of the linked controls that are active (lookup of soc2_controls.active_code; inactive ones come back empty).

fields.name: events
fields.description: Inverse of soc2_events.event_type: captured occurrences of this event type. Written only by soc2-capture.

tables.name: soc2_capture_runs
tables.description: SOC 2 Evidence · Map MigGon37539, created 2026-10-14. One row per run of the soc2-capture script (record-triggered or hourly): counts, skip reasons, errors, trace detail and config issues. status running doubles as the lock for the hourly run. Writer: soc2-capture automations only. Docs: stories/MapMigGon37539/data-implementation-plan.md §1.3.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Primary. cap-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<input> (UTC start).

fields.name: mode
fields.description: record: triggered by one source row. hourly: safety net over all sources.

fields.name: trigger_table
fields.description: Source table that triggered the run (record mode).

fields.name: trigger_record_id
fields.description: Source record id that triggered the run (record mode).

fields.name: status
fields.description: running (lock), success, partial (some events failed), failure (run could not complete), abandoned (running too long, closed by the next run).

fields.name: dry_run
fields.description: Run with dryRun = yes: evaluated everything, wrote no evidence.

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: Run start (UTC).

fields.name: finished_at
fields.description: Run end (UTC).

fields.name: evaluated
fields.description: Source rows evaluated.

fields.name: captured
fields.description: Events written and confirmed.

fields.name: existing
fields.description: Events already captured (same event_key): no-op.

fields.name: skipped
fields.description: Rows that matched no enabled event or failed validation; reasons in skip_reasons.

fields.name: traced
fields.description: Events detected for types in trace status (not written).

fields.name: failed
fields.description: Events whose write failed after bounded retries.

fields.name: skip_reasons
fields.description: JSON: reason -> count (e.g. missing_fields, test_data, status_paused).

fields.name: trace
fields.description: JSON list of what trace-status events would have written (event_key, source record, outcome), capped per run.

fields.name: errors
fields.description: JSON list: kind (validation, rate_limit, transient), record, short message, attempts. No payloads.

fields.name: config_issues
fields.description: Differences between the script registry and soc2_event_types (missing rows, version mismatch, unknown codes).

fields.name: script_version
fields.description: Version of soc2-capture that ran.

fields.name: created
fields.description: Server time the run row was created.

fields.name: events
fields.description: Inverse of soc2_events.capture_run: events captured by this run.

tables.name: soc2_events
tables.description: SOC 2 Evidence · Map MigGon37539, created 2026-10-14. The evidence: one row per captured occurrence of an enabled event type, idempotent on event_key, confirmed after re-read. Only ids, statuses, times, actor and counts; no task, file or report content. Writer: soc2-capture automations only; reviewers read through interfaces. Docs: stories/MapMigGon37539/data-implementation-plan.md §1.2 and soc2-event-catalog.md §4.

fields.name: event_key
fields.description: Primary. event_code:source_record_id:produced_at (ISO UTC). Idempotency key: a key that already exists is a no-op, never an update.

fields.name: source_table
fields.description: Source table (name and id).

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Source record id (traceability).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Link to the source row in Map King Hub.

fields.name: run_ref
fields.description: The source's own id: Loom run_id, ingestion source_file, automation workflow id.

fields.name: produced_at
fields.description: When the event happened according to the source (written by the producer).

fields.name: source_recorded_at
fields.description: Server time of the source row (Airtable created or last-modified time).

fields.name: actor
fields.description: Who acted: agent:Loom, agent:Ingestion Agent, automation:<name>, plus the requester when known.

fields.name: trigger
fields.description: How the source run started: schedule, slack:#ingestion <person>, record, hourly.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Outcome of the event.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One line without content: counts, short reason.

fields.name: details
fields.description: JSON with counts and codes only. Never task text, file contents or reports.

fields.name: ai_output_state
fields.description: present, missing, malformed, not_applicable (parent criteria D4, E6). AI text is never copied.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.description: Set by the capture module after re-reading the stored record. Unconfirmed rows are never shown as evidence and stay for reprocessing.

fields.name: is_test
fields.description: Test data (before go-live, TEST/QA-TEST, sample files, dry runs). Kept for QA, never exported.

fields.name: integrity_hash
fields.description: Optional hash of the observed fields at capture time.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: The studied event this row is an occurrence of. Filled once, at creation.

fields.name: capture_run
fields.description: The soc2_capture_runs row that captured this event.

fields.name: recorded_at
fields.description: Server time of capture. This is the evidence timestamp (exported as recorded_at, ISO UTC).

fields.name: last_modified
fields.description: Last change to any field. Used by modified_after_capture to detect edits after capture.

fields.name: event_code
fields.description: Lookup of the event type code (for views and the CSV).

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Lookup of the event type name (CSV column event_name).

fields.name: category
fields.description: Lookup of the event type SOC 2 category.

fields.name: control_codes
fields.description: Active SOC 2 control codes mapped to the event type (lookup of soc2_event_types.active_control_codes). Empty = unmapped evidence.

fields.name: mapping_provisional
fields.description: Lookup of the event type mapping_provisional flag (CSV column).

fields.name: modified_after_capture
fields.description: 1 when the row changed more than 2 minutes after capture (the module's own confirmation falls inside the margin). Such rows leave the export until reviewed.

fields.name: event_status
fields.description: Current status of the event type (enabled, trace, paused, disabled). Informative: what is exported depends on export_ok.

fields.name: export_ok
fields.description: 1 when the row is exportable evidence: confirmed, not test data, not modified after capture. The per-control page and the CSV show only these.
